mechanisms: Early-exit validation in execute (each require! a direct return) makes the later helper call sites cold under static BPI: LLVM's InlineCostCallAnalyzer then disallows all bonuses, including the 15000 last-call-to-static bonus, and caps the threshold at ColdCallSiteThreshold=45. The wallet and sweep helpers stay out of line (86 calls). The original's 154+3 calls in one 27,400 B function imply its validation reaches the helper calls through one merge (a Result-returning helper, method or closure behind a single ?).

A sibling-style validate method (296 inside the holder arm as in create_v2, let-else at 306, require_keys_neq! at 307, require!(t!=hk&&t!=sk) at 312) reproduces the original's to_string inline/outline choice at all 12 validation sites and lddw=86. This independently confirms the #2370 gene.

With registers and frame offsets masked and chunks paired by call label (placement-independent), main b5975fa is 0.8744 similar to the original. The tail call order already equals the original. The remaining structural gap is validation error-block order plus 312/307 to_string. The two large CPI chunks (0.86 and 0.96) differ only in spills and one mint Rc-clone block emitted before an accounts-pointer reload; to_account_info order is identical.

Frame: the spill area starts at orig 0x8d8 vs ours 0x8c0 (24 B), and below it spill slots are permuted rather than shifted. Clean-room rewrites move the frame almost entirely (16-30 equal offsets vs main 162), so a rewrite is not a route to the frame.
